## Methods

The top 15 of 20 enriched terms from an over-representation (ORA) analysis were shown as a dot plot. The x-axis is gene ratio, dot color the -log10 of the adjusted p-value, and dot size the gene count. The enrichment analysis was performed upstream; this figure summarises its output. Drawn in R 4.4.1 with ggplot2 3.5.1.

## Plot configuration

The complete plot configuration is in `plot_config.yaml`.
